explanation: Copy the original matrix. For every destination cell, scan its original row and original column; clear it if either contains zero. Reading only the copy prevents newly written zeros from propagating, and writing individual cells preserves row objects.
timeComplexity: O(R C (R+C)) worst-case time for R rows and C columns.
spaceComplexity: O(R C) auxiliary space for the copied matrix.
